recorded.outcome:q-threads:c: PDLP splits its vectors into shards for the threads, the roundoff depends on the number of shards, and reproducible results need the same number.
recorded.prompt:q-threads:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-threads:d: the roundoff depends on the number of shards, and reproducible results need the same number. So the thread count is part of what a run promises
